_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-06-30 · Session 88 (SkyThru) · checkpoint — CCC-metric match · MIL vs JST data element + Veteran Star · About-box z-index · MAP Users 3 new fields
_status: Four COBI tweaks shipped + live. (1) KPI Trends 'CCC Collaborative' now shows the statewide-EXHIBIT count (132) to match the MAP Exhibits card — it was quietly showing adopting-colleges (61). (2) NEW MIL vs JST data element: the Veteran Sprint card shows the REAL JSTs uploaded (≈23.5k) + reported service members (MIL ≈34.1k) + the 75% star rule (was a stand-in number); the College Activity table gains a 'MIL / JST' column and its ⭐ is now the Veteran Star (uploaded JSTs ≥ 75% of reported MIL) instead of the near-always-on criteria star. (3) The About box no longer slips behind the cards. (4) The 3 new MAP Custom Report fields (Active/Inactive · Disciplines · Last-updated) now flow into the MAP Users tab — public 'N active' counts + a richer reviewer roster. HEADS-UP for Sam: the table's per-college Veteran Star uses the exact 75% rule (~46 colleges); MAP's official tally is 50 — the 4-college gap is boundary cases (the savings API has no per-college star flag), flag if it bugs you.
